title: Complete genre map: all26 families,30 tropes and14 scenarios with actual contract boundaries
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete genre/scenario coverage map and companion/assignment proposals, scoped historical source and implementation limits
reviews.disposition:
Complete review covers all435 input lines:14 fiction premises/three game contrasts, PF01–PF26, T01–T30 and five compositions, eight creature/relationship contracts, three invented creatures, all S01–S14 seeds/five worked cards, cross-system interactions, eight source-fit rows/five shared contracts, illustrative helper data, delivery/failure matrices, five candidates and three targeted source questions. All original IDs and ideas remain; linked bodies are not reviewed by proxy.

**The map measures design treatment, not prevalence or readiness.** Fresh/prior/lead, added/extended and small/medium/large have their stated meanings. A synopsis establishes a premise rather than a complete acquisition/retention law; a developer listing does not establish every combat/trait rule or current behavior. “Added” means treated here rather than never considered before. A broad institution, monster, card, dungeon or support row does not prove a missing runtime subsystem or create an implementation assignment. The October1 ordinary-event-first/one-realm/prestige statements are historical proposals and the retired milestone; [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and current [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) own today's sequence.

**Useful creature distinctions stay intact.** A living individual, acquired/captured individual, learned imprint, patron spirit, rider/mount, player form, manufactured helper and habitat/colony have different identity, agency and settlement. Purchase/rescue/hatching/pact does not automatically create trust, competence or ownership of every associated power. Pattern knowledge and a manifested instance differ; evolution, temporary form, fusion and inheritance are separate operations. An instance's name/species can change while identity remains. Assignment at one site cannot also consume the same worker/time elsewhere without actual concurrency or multibody means. Witnesses learn through their channels rather than the player's private history.

The one-helper field proof is not a global ownership cap. Fixed slots/rooms, universal drawbacks, guaranteed retraining, safe bench housing, all-forms-preserve-everything and previewed-only death are original prototype policies. Real body/world/contract rules can differ, including strong independent help, innate competence, irreversible loss or unknown danger. A large reserve or domain can actually remove a former limitation; do not invent compensatory counters or ongoing chores. [Current skills](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md), [cheat cosmology](CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md) and actual world owners decide the causal limits. An actual copy/rewind may produce another person when supported; save integrity prevents accidental duplication, not an intended capability.

**Scenarios preserve choices without forcing equal outcomes.** S01–S14 and their five worked cards supply useful rescue, examination, relief, management and treaty questions. Objective survival, injury, sample/cargo condition, evidence provenance, permission, stock and rival motive are separate state facts. Support can resolve a mission directly; kill totals are not its only outcome. The exact two-of-three phase budget, mandatory baseline substitute, legal admission prerequisite, equal-yield options and unconditional safe withdrawal are proposed local contracts, not a universal rule. Strength, a supported bypass or a power may alter those constraints through its actual mechanism. A callback need not generate a new reward or another grind; quiet texture is useful too.

**Repeat progress and production need their actual contracts.** Repeated settled first-clear rewards, duplicated reserve refunds and the same event applied twice are integrity defects. Genuine repeat training, renewable rewards, recursive-but-terminating interactions, profitable trade, unlimited production supplied by a real source or actual capacity creation are possible. PF19/S08's anti-arbitrage/infinite-output wording does not authorize unsolicited anti-exploit rules. Account for true sources, inputs, workers, clock and custody; do not force a price or cap solely to stop strength. Preview is pure and knowledge-safe; a commitment records only its actual reservation/draw point. Sharing a calculation does not mean showing its hidden truth or drawing a new outcome during inspection.

**Contracts are not current integration.** The helper JSON is explicitly illustrative. Capability query, assignment, committed event, scoped consequence and definition/state separation describe useful seams without creating another actor/knowledge/reward/scheduler owner. A receipt alone does not spend, publish, save or establish single-writer ownership. The October1 module/race/party/offline observations remain dated source evidence; no current missing system is established. Unknown versions and missing content preserve recoverable data under the selected compatibility policy; new persistence follows actual publication and migration/explicit compatibility. [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and optional human review govern the selected slice. Current explanations need legitimate knowledge rather than omniscient adapter/hidden-law refusals.

No source novel/PDF/reference page, present game/source code, primary corpus or personal save was newly inspected. No acquisition, lane launch, gameplay edit, test/build/browser, deletion, relocation, commit or push occurred. Reopen the named PF/T/S/contract row for a selected real consumer with its own source and delivery evidence.
reviews.evidence: Read all435 pre-fold lines in1–150,151–300,301–435, including every table cell and illustrative code. Source/reference/linked body and current runtime not reverified.
reviews.reopen: Use named PF/T/S or contract row for current selected consumer; qualify actual source, identity, settlement and implementation rather than importing the old milestone/queue.
